releases.title: Snake v0.1.1: visible board grid
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Same game as v0.1.0 with the artist's revised board tile: the 20x20 grid is now clearly visible (answers QA game-developer#4, R2/R9).

**How to start:** download `snake-v0.1.1.zip`, unzip, open `snake/index.html` in a browser, or run `python3 -m http.server 8000` inside `snake/` and open http://localhost:8000/. Arrow keys steer. Enter/Space or the button start and play again. P/Esc pauses.

Provenance: game-developer `b69e52783c00521ba5d602b2798c6646d4aa94c0` + artist `assets/` at `a8aa59ba7cfe63056d7e1898edd287fe454743d2` (BUILD.txt in the zip).

Checked: `python3 checks/run_checks.py` on the delivery assembled by `ht-role delivery`, headless Chromium with real key presses: 32/32 pass. Screenshots are in `checks/out/`; `00-laptop-1366x768.png` shows the grid.

releases.title: Snake v0.1.0: full game, playable
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
First playable build of the whole objective: title screen, arrow-key steering on a 20x20 grid, food grows the snake one cell and adds a point, wall and self collision end the game, live score, game-over screen with final score and Play again.

**How to start:** download `snake-v0.1.0.zip`, unzip, open `snake/index.html` in a browser (or run `python3 -m http.server 8000` inside `snake/` and open http://localhost:8000/). Arrow keys steer; Enter/Space or the button start and play again; P/Esc pauses.

Provenance: game-developer `0b856b853ac00bfa7b3b42f1e5663d7245faf1c9` + artist `assets/` at `67a4583812e38b740765f4920b0e1485b7903382` (BUILD.txt in the zip).

Checked: `python3 checks/run_checks.py snake` on the unpacked zip, headless Chromium with real key presses: 28/28 pass (screenshots in `checks/out/` of the repository).
